# CoParallel+ / CoTheoryAll

> Public experimental interactive research comparison of time and related explanatory lenses, with source and uncertainty preserved. Not a validated physical theory or local runtime.

- [CoCivium existing machine index](https://github.com/CoCivium/CoCivium/blob/main/ai/index.json)
- [Project first-use and current limitations](https://github.com/CoCivium/CoCivium/blob/main/START_HERE.md)

No automatic authority, scraping, email, telemetry, local-device access, or scientific endorsement is implied.
